steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Come in.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: ...Dr. Kal'tsit!

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Amiya...

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: ...{@nickname}.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: So you've come.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Ahem.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Chief Wei, the other two representatives of Rhodes Island have also arrived.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: Ah, excellent.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: Please take a seat. Miss Kal'tsit is currently explaining the situation to me.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Allow me to continue then. Mister Wei, I trust that you have a good grasp of the situation already.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Currently, the Lungmen information network captures a lot of information regarding the Reunion Movement. It is good that you recognize the importance of this.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: But this alone is not enough. Lungmen still lacks key information.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: I believe the L.G.D. knows very well that this simple quarantine is not enough to hold back Reunion.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Reunion will not obediently go through the inspections, nor will they wait for the authorities to take the initiative. That's why...

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Without Rhodes Island's assistance, Lungmen will suffer heavy losses against Reunion should you decide to pursue the same strategies against the Infected.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Pardon the interruption.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: The L.G.D. understands Lungmen's defenses better than Rhodes Island does. We've already made preparations to deal with possible infiltration from Reunion.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: We, however, are not obliged to provide you with confidential information regarding our operations.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: Miss Kal'tsit, please continue.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: While it is true that Lungmen has been successful in dealing with unarmed Infected so far, you have not dealt with this scale of organized rioting before. This may result in unnecessary losses.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: From our experience... Only the Infected are capable of countering the Infected.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: To my understand, Rhodes Island has some special expertise in countering Reunion?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: We do have experience, but I wouldn't call it expertise.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: I've been told that Rhodes Island was involved with the Chernobog incident, and managed to obtain a lot of intel about Reunion.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: No matter where you heard that from...

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: At this stage, that information is not up for exchange. It is but a part of our resume, a qualification that allows us to speak to you, Mister Wei.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: It is Lungmen that will decide whether or not we will exchange information. If Rhodes Island cannot even provide us with this level of information...

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: Hah.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: In that case, we simply have no basis for trusting your capabilities.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Mister Wei, I apologise if my words were not clear enough.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: What I must emphasize is... the only reason Rhodes Island has this information, is because we were strong enough to obtain it.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Whatever the case may be, Lungmen cannot simply trust another group of Infected.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Miss Ch'en, if you believe that doling out punishment to the Infected is more important than the actual security of Lungmen...

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Then I will immediately surrender myself in accordance with your local laws. Then, I will sigh from my jail while watching Reunion burn down your city.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: This time, Lungmen doesn't have a choice.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Your good intentions are not lost upon us despite your rudeness.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: However, we also are not a charity for useless lobbyists.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: Madam Ch'en.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Chief Wei, I believe it is inappropriate for these outsiders to get involved with Lungmen's confidential matters.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: Calm down, Madam Ch'en. They are still our guests.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: ... My guests.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Very well.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Unless they've violated our laws, I will tolerate them, Sir.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: Ah, excuse me. I just remembered...

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: That's right. Hmm...

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: There is one thing that I care about.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: Your ability.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: To my understanding, Rhodes Island is also assisting with suppressing the nearby Infected?

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: Madam Ch'en, based upon your best information, how would you assess Rhodes Island's combat abilities?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: ... Allow me to describe what I've witnessed from Rhodes Island's operations.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Here are the details...
